name: OSS_BALANCE_OBJECTS
description: Following table is used to capture object information.

columns.name: BALANCE_OBJECT_FULL_NAME
columns.description: Field denoting the balance object full name.

columns.name: BALANCE_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Field denoting the balance object name.

columns.name: BALANCE_OBJECT_TABLE
columns.description: Field for capturing the value of Balance object table.

columns.name: KEY_ATTRIBUTE1_NAME
columns.description: This field tracks the the name of first key attribute.

columns.name: KEY_ATTRIBUTE2_NAME
columns.description: This field tracks the the name of second key attribute.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN1
columns.description: This field tracks the the name of first primary attribute.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN2
columns.description: This field tracks the the name of second primary attribute.

columns.name: TABLE_ALIAS
columns.description: This field tracks the the name of table alias.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
